generate_unconditional_audio: generate unconditional audio samples using a pretrained generative model with a specified number of samples
generate_text_conditioned_audio: generate audio samples conditioned on text descriptions using the model generate method
generate_audio_continuation: generate audio continuation from an existing audio prompt waveform with optional text descriptions
generate_audio_from_tokens: generate audio waveforms from discrete audio tokens using the compression model decoder
get_pretrained_genmodel: load a pretrained audio generative model by name for inference on a specified device
